judgeIssues.detail: Intra-run rendering collision for the launch-model name: the card title “Custom auction” is translated (“Leilão personalizado”) while its own section heading i=4404 “Custom Auctions” and the sibling model names Crowd Launch (4399/4401) and Instant Launch (4406/4408, matching shipped) are all kept in English. The same product model is shown to the user under two different names.

evidence.rule: Launch-model names kept verbatim in this locale (Crowd Launch / Instant Launch, per shipped translations)

entries.translation: Lançamentos de token totalmente personalizáveis para inicializar liquidez e distribuir tokens de forma justa, com tecnologia do protocolo CCA da Uniswap.

judgeIssues.detail: The glossary maps "auctions" → "leilões" (ratified noun), and it is applied elsewhere in the app (e.g. "Auctions", "Explore auctions", "Filter auctions" contexts render as leilões). Unlike "Crowd Launch"/"Instant Launch", which shipped translations treat as branded launch-model names kept in English, "Custom Auctions" is described generically ("Fully customizable token launches… powered by Uniswap's CCA protocol") and is not in the DNT list, so leaving it in English breaks glossary compliance and cross-app consistency. Noting for human review: if the team decides this is a branded launch-model name like its siblings, keeping English would be the right call — the glossary entry does not currently say so.

entries.translation: Lançamentos padronizados imediatamente negociáveis. O preço é definido por uma bonding curve, com as tarifas a reverter para liquidez bloqueada. Lançados via Pools.xyz.

judgeIssues.detail: “claim” is rendered “reivindicar” here but “reclamar” in the adjacent strings i=4479/4480 (“reclamar os seus tokens”, “janela de reclamação”) and in the shipped translation “Claim UNI token → Reclamar token UNI”. Same source term, two target renderings, on the same auction timeline UI.

evidence.rule: Shipped rendering: Claim → reclamar (“Reclamar token UNI”)
